dog.description_text: A volunteer writes: Sweet words and treats are the way to Fenrir's heart. This shy young boy came to the Care Center when his previous person developed medical issues and could no longer care for him. Fearful at first, Fenrir now opens up to the humans who come to meet and greet him, especially when they bring him yummy lickable churu. Our behavior team describedÂ him as calm, sweet, and timid but with a slow approach and baby talk, totally fine with pettings on his head and body. FenrirÂ is a good soul who found himself without the comforts of his old home, including his sibling cat who he got on very well with but has already been chosen. He's hearty, handsome, and ready to be part of a real forever family--make it happen for our boy Fenrir today!
dog.name: Fenrir
